hook.name: DoodlHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for doodlpad pools. Takes a fee (up to 1.25% of each swap's unspecified amount) split among the pool's creator, a vault, and the platform owner via afterSwapReturnDelta. Gates trading and liquidity additions until the factory opens the pool; exempts a designated painter address from fees and the trading gate.
